name: Interest/Curiosity Accumulation Circuit
short_description: Accumulates information gap evidence and novelty signals, weighted by perceived competence to resolve gaps, generating curiosity levels and exploration thresholds.

components.name: INFO_GAP_DETECTOR
components.description: Detects discrepancies between current knowledge and environmental information

components.name: NOVELTY_ACCUMULATOR
components.description: Accumulates novelty signal over time and stimulus exposure

components.name: COMPETENCE_ESTIMATOR
components.description: Assesses ability to understand or explore information gap (threshold effect)

components.name: EXPLORE_THRESHOLD_GEN
components.description: Generates curiosity signal and detects exploration threshold crossing

scope_conditions: Presence of information gaps in environment
key_references: Loewenstein, G. (1994). The psychology of curiosity: A review and reinterpretation. Psychological Bulletin, 116(1), 75–98.
Kidd, C., & Hayden, B. Y. (2015). The psychology and neuroscience of curiosity. Neuron, 88(3), 449–460.
design_implications: Moderate information gaps optimize curiosity; design educational environments with partial cues, progressive reveals, and scaffolded complexity to maintain interest
Self-efficacy modulates exploration; ensure environments provide evidence of competence, attainable challenges, and clear pathways for knowledge acquisition
